experiment: Bidirectional orchestrator failover live failure-injection validation
failure_injection_method: Temporarily changed only the orchestrator's upstream URL to 127.0.0.1:9, forcing a deterministic connection-refused error. The original URL was captured before injection and restored by an EXIT trap and explicit restore. Edge and Cloud inference deployments were not scaled or stopped.

edge_to_cloud.injected_failure: Orchestrator Edge URL temporarily set to http://127.0.0.1:9
edge_to_cloud.fallback_reason: Edge inference failed (connection refused); fallback to cloud

cloud_to_edge.injected_failure: Orchestrator Cloud URL temporarily set to http://127.0.0.1:9
cloud_to_edge.fallback_reason: Cloud inference failed (connection refused); fallback to edge

policy: Failover is only attempted for high-priority workloads. Client-side 4xx errors are not retried. Fallback requires the alternate service health endpoint to succeed. If fallback inference also fails, the orchestrator returns HTTP 503 with both failure details.
scope_boundary: This was an orchestrator-to-upstream route failure injection, not a shutdown of the Edge or Cloud inference deployment. It validates connection failure handling and cross-tier retry behaviour without stopping either production inference service.
